title: Gap Analysis Request
description: Request to identify missing capabilities given a desired set.

desired.description: Desired capabilities, each described by a schema or identity.

schema.description: For kind=schema: expected schema name (prefix match ok).

minimum_version.description: Minimum acceptable version for partial matches.

map_artifact_id.description: ID of the capability-map artifact to analyze (from a prior inspector firing). If absent, the gap-analyzer reads all schema artifacts itself.
